{
  const fk = transpose(france_kpi_js)[0];
  const pk = transpose(paris_kpi_js)[0];
  const lk = transpose(lyon_kpi_js)[0];
  const bxk = transpose(bordeaux_kpi_js)[0];
  const babk = transpose(bab_kpi_js)[0];

  const cities = [
    {name:"Paris", kpi:pk}, {name:"Lyon", kpi:lk},
    {name:"Bordeaux", kpi:bxk}, {name:"BAB", kpi:babk}
  ];
  const fN = (n) => Math.round(n).toLocaleString("fr-FR");

  // Per-city ranking line
  const rkLine = (key) => cities
    .map(c => ({name:c.name, val:c.kpi[key]}))
    .filter(c => c.val != null)
    .sort((a,b) => b.val - a.val)
    .map((c,i) => `<span style="color:${i===0?'#0a4c6a':'#6b7280'};font-weight:${i===0?700:400};">${c.name} ${typeof c.val==='number'&&c.val%1!==0?c.val.toFixed(1):c.val}</span>`)
    .join(" \u00b7 ");

  const kItem = (key, val, label, color) => `<div class="kpi-item">
    <span class="kv" style="color:${color};">${val}</span>
    <span class="kl">${label}</span>
    <div class="kt">${rkLine(key)}</div>
  </div>`;
  const kNarr = (html) => `<div class="kpi-narr">${html}</div>`;

  const d = document.createElement("div");
  d.innerHTML = `
  <div class="kpi-panel" style="width:100%;">
    <div class="kpi-header">
      <span>Synth\u00e8se France \u00b7 4 villes</span>
      <span style="font-size:10px;opacity:0.7;">Source : Inside Airbnb, juin 2025</span>
    </div>
    <div class="kpi-blocs">
      <div class="kpi-bloc">
        <div class="kpi-bloc-title" style="border-color:#0a4c6a;color:#0a4c6a;">March\u00e9</div>
        ${kItem("n_listings", fN(fk.n_listings), "annonces actives", "#0a4c6a")}
        ${kItem("n_hosts", fN(fk.n_hosts || 0), "h\u00f4tes distincts", "#0a4c6a")}
        ${kItem("pct_entire", fk.pct_entire+"%", "logements entiers", "#0a4c6a")}
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-bloc">
        <div class="kpi-bloc-title" style="border-color:#ca5800;color:#ca5800;">Prix & Activit\u00e9</div>
        ${kItem("prix_med", fk.prix_med+"\u00a0\u20ac", "prix m\u00e9dian / nuit", "#ca5800")}
        ${kItem("prix_med_entire", fk.prix_med_entire+"\u00a0\u20ac", "logement entier (m\u00e9d.)", "#ca5800")}
        ${kItem("dispo_med", fk.dispo_med+" j", "disponibilit\u00e9 m\u00e9d. / an", "#0a4c6a")}
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-bloc">
        <div class="kpi-bloc-title" style="border-color:#6d1a36;color:#6d1a36;">Professionnalisation</div>
        ${kItem("pct_multi", fk.pct_multi+"%", "multi-h\u00f4tes (>1 ann.)", "#6d1a36")}
        ${kNarr(`<strong style="color:#6d1a36;">${fk.top10_share}\u202f%</strong> des annonces g\u00e9r\u00e9es par les 10\u202f% d\u2019h\u00f4tes les plus actifs`)}
        ${kItem("pct_longterm", fk.pct_longterm+"%", "longue dur\u00e9e (\u226530 nuits)", "#6d1a36")}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
  return d;
}
{
  const data = transpose(europe_bench_data);
  const COUNTRY_COL = {
    FRA:"#002395", GBR:"#C8102E", ITA:"#008C45", ESP:"#F1BF00",
    DEU:"#333333", PRT:"#006600", GRC:"#0D5EAF", NLD:"#FF6F00",
    AUT:"#EF3340", BEL:"#FDDA24", CZE:"#11457E", DNK:"#C60C30",
    HUN:"#477050", IRL:"#169B62", NOR:"#BA0C2F", SWE:"#006AA7",
    TUR:"#E30A17", CHE:"#D52B1E", LVA:"#9E3039"
  };
  const tableMod = await import(new URL("helpers/jcn-tableojs.js", document.baseURI).href);
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.id = "bench-europe-c";
  yield container;

  tableMod.buildDataTable(container, data, {
    keys: ["n_listings","prix_med_entire",
      "pct_entire","pct_multi","pct_longterm",
      "listings_1000hab","listings_1000hsg","entire_1000hsg",
      "ratio_lh","cr_offre_10plus","dispo_med"],
    groups: [
      {label:"Stock", cols:["n_listings"]},
      {label:"Prix", cols:["prix_med_entire"]},
      {label:"Structure", cols:["pct_entire","pct_multi","pct_longterm"]},
      {label:"Pression", cols:["listings_1000hab","listings_1000hsg","entire_1000hsg"]},
      {label:"Concentration", cols:["ratio_lh","cr_offre_10plus"]},
      {label:"Activit\u00e9", cols:["dispo_med"]}
    ],
    labelCol: "city_fr",
    labelFallback: "city",
    colorCol: "country_code",
    colorMap: COUNTRY_COL,
    subCol: "top_host",
    defaultSort: "listings_1000hab",
    maxHeight: 360
  });
}
